Package org.cibseven.connect.impl

Class ConnectorEndpointPolicy

java.lang.Object
org.cibseven.connect.impl.ConnectorEndpointPolicy
public final class ConnectorEndpointPolicy extends Object
Opt-in allow-list of the endpoints a connector may contact, so that targets taken from process variables cannot redirect requests and their credentials.

First set wins: cibseven.connect.<connectorId>.allowed-endpoints, CIBSEVEN_CONNECT_<CONNECTOR_ID>_ALLOWED_ENDPOINTS, "cibseven.connect.allowed-endpoints", "CIBSEVEN_CONNECT_ALLOWED_ENDPOINTS". A connector's own value replaces the global one; "*" exempts it. Entries are scheme://[*.]host[:port], compared without DNS resolution; invalid entries are ignored with a warning.
